name: Lipstick
description: Guidelines for traveling with lipstick in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Solid lipsticks, lip balms, and chapsticks are fully allowed in carry-on without size limits. Liquid lip gloss must comply with the 3-1-1 rule.

checkedBag.reason: Lipstick and lip gloss are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring lipstick on a plane?

travelTips: Solid lipsticks, lip balms, and chapsticks are fully allowed in carry-on without size limits. Liquid lip gloss must comply with the 3-1-1 rule.

faq.question: Is lipstick allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Lipstick is allowed in carry-on luggage. Solid lipsticks, lip balms, and chapsticks are fully allowed in carry-on without size limits. Liquid lip gloss must comply with the 3-1-1 rule.

faq.question: Can you pack lipstick in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Lipstick is allowed in checked bags. Lipstick and lip gloss are allowed in checked baggage.
